mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically for three consecutive weeks (-71.1 to -67.4), indicating an ongoing recovery trend that is likely to persist into the next four weeks absent a reversal signal.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved each week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the last 28 days despite the prior three-week monotonic rise.

evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from -28.7 to -21.3 over the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 2 weeks even as GROCERY_PHARM continues to trend upward.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility drops more than 20 points week-on-week, it signals a sudden tightening of mobility restrictions or public fear response that will suppress RETAIL_REC over the following week.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has remained near -69 to -70 with no sharp drop currently observed
failure_condition: No such 20-point weekly TRANSIT drop is observed in the horizon window, or RETAIL_REC still rises despite such a drop.

mechanism_narrative: Rising WORKPLACES mobility combined with a simultaneous decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility jointly indicate a shift back to pre-pandemic routines, amplifying RETAIL_REC growth beyond what either series alone would predict.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth over 4 weeks is no greater than in periods where only one of WORKPLACES or RESIDENTIAL moved favorably, indicating no interaction effect.

failure_condition: PARKS trend shows a sustained directional move (e.g., 3+ consecutive weekly increases) that correlates with a corresponding RETAIL_REC move, indicating seasonal signal was actually present and ignored.

candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week change <= 0 while TRANSIT remains below -60
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remained between -68.6 and -70.4 throughout the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise over 2 weeks even when WORKPLACES stalls and TRANSIT stays below -60, falsifying the policy-cap mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: The pace of RETAIL_REC improvement has been decelerating in magnitude over the last two weeks (+1.1 then +2.0 points after an initial +1.1), suggesting the recovery trend may plateau; if the week-on-week gain falls below 1.0 point, this signals a stalling mechanism that caps further 4-week gains.

evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC gains were +1.1, +0.6, +2.0 across the three most recent weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise at an accelerating or stable rate beyond 1 week despite a sub-1.0 point weekly gain trigger, or reverses direction entirely.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined each week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over 4 weeks even as RESIDENTIAL continues its decline, or RESIDENTIAL decline coincides with flat/falling RETAIL_REC in a tightening regime.
